text: Archdruids of the Flame are night elves in Moonkin Form, Cat Form, and Bear Form in the form of runebears located at the Wellspring of Life in the Emerald Dream during the quest The Age of Mortals. Despite being red to the player, they will only attack if attacked first.

The Archive is the nexus of earthen civilization in Khaz Algar. There, memories are cycled, catalogued, and stored at the end of an earthen's scheduled rotation. A task that is done by the Archivists. It is located on the western edge of the Coreway in southwestern Dornogal. Ten thousand years ago, the Great Sundering damaged the great machines of the earthen, including the Archive, eventually leading to its shutdown. While their memory gems could still be stored within it, the earthen lost the ability to access the memories held in the gems. Eventually High Speaker Eirich sent Speaker Brinthe away to Dornogal to serve on the Council of Dornogal in his stead and preside over the restoration
Archaic Venomancer's Footwraps drop from Ki'katal the Harvester in Ara-Kara, City of Echoes.

The Arcanovoid Construct is an arcane golem mount has a chance to drop from Nullaeus in his delve lair, Torment's Rise. During Midnight Season 1, it was rewarded from the Let Me Solo Him: Nullaeus feat of strength.
Arclight Energy (in-game as just Arc Energy) is the virtual currency used to upgrade Warcraft Minis. It is needed along with Upgrade Cores and Star Points to upgrade a unit in rarity.
Archmage Pentarus' Flying Machine is a gyrocopter located at Krasus' Landing in Dalaran. It belongs to Archmage Pentarus and can be used to reach Sholazar Basin.

Archmage Kel'Thuzad is a projection of Kel'Thuzad before becoming a necromancer found in his pocket dimension. He was encountered by Kalecgos and an adventurer after they used a an Emerald Necklace. After releasing some Fragmented Souls, the mirror image ranted about the Kirin Tor and allowed the pair to leave, which released the magic from the necklace. Afterward, Kalecgos proclaimed the mirror image gone.

Area Death (TEST) is an ability used only for testing purposes. It was the on use effect for Martin Fury (shirt)#Original, prior to the patch 3.2.0 change. In July 2026, a group was able to time a Mythic+23 run after a Game Master used internal GM‑only spells which consisted of this spell and Death Touch to instantly kill enemies and bosses. Blizzard confirmed the misuse, fired the employee, and said the involved players would also face action, calling the event isolated and thanking the community for reporting it.

The Atal'Akunda are the followers of the loa Akunda, who is considered to be amongst Zandalar's greatest loa. They accept all who seek sanctuary from the dangers of Vol'dun or desires to abandon their old life and lead a new one. Through a sacred ritual, Akunda enters the minds of his followers and removes the memories that cause them pain. Most wish to dispose only of some of their memories, but some decide to get rid of everything, even their names and take on the name of their loa and add a surename that describes who they are now. Azj-Kahet ( ) is a subterranean zone located in the deepest part of Khaz Algar, south and below Hallowfall and the Ringing Deeps. The high capital of nerubian society, Azj-Kahet is home to the last kingdom of living nerubians. Unlike Azjol-Nerub, which was consumed by the Scourge, Azj-Kahet represents nerubian society as it once was—deadly survivors of mythic wars that have played out time and again over millennia. The zone is dominated by the sprawling City of Threads, which has been built on top of itself over and over as its districts decay, with the highest locations reserved for the wealthy and those who have the favor of Queen Ansurek. Azmourne is an alternate universe of Azeroth, visited during the Time Rifts, in which the Lich King and his armies succeeded in scourging the world. The Lich King encounter takes place atop the Frozen Throne, much like the main timeline encounter. After the encounter, players notice a Gilded Vase in a place of prominence atop Icecrown.

Azewrath is an alternate universe of Azeroth, visited during the Time Rifts. Azewrath is in a time when the Burning Legion won the War of the Ancients 10,000 years ago, which drastically changed the outcome of the war and led to the fel corruption of many races. The Illidan Stormrage boss encounter takes place on a Legion ship, reusing the Kil'jaeden map in Tomb of Sargeras.

is a land of cloud-ringed mountains and hidden bamboo thickets in Pandaria's eastern shore.]] Bamboo is a plant found in Pandaria, the Wandering Isle, the Lost Isles, and Stranglethorn Vale. It grows in dense forests and thickets. Strong and springy, bamboo is used as a material for various purposes, especially on the Wandering Isle and throughout Pandaria. It can also be eaten. Pandaren buildings such as the Lazy Turnip inn are composed of bamboo poles. Murloc huts can also be made of bamboo. Anglers Wharf is made up of watertight bamboo houses on stilts, which are designed to be rebuilt every time the sea washes them away. Pandaren boats use planks of waxed bamboo wood. The battle for Tyr's Hand was a conflict between the Argent Crusade and the Scarlet Crusade for control over Tyr's Hand. After the zealots were mysteriously turned into undead, the Brotherhood of the Light and one hundred centurions were tasked with conquering the city. With the help of adventurers, the Argent Crusade ultimately succeeded in capturing the stronghold, ending the threat of Crusader Lord Valdelmar.

Belzt is a giant ramolith located on the Isle of Dorn. Once a year, he duels with his brother Durzan on Thunderhead Peak. The clash of their horns heralds the storm above Rambleshire and brings prosperity to its residents for another year. In ancient times their seismic brawling resulted in several tremors which caused quarry-collapses. Shado-Pan daily quests rotate through sets of quests for the Defenders, the Omnia Mystics, and the Wu Kao Assassins on different days. When the Defenders are active, heroes may ask one of them (other than Snowdrift) to accompany them on the day's missions. BlizzCon 2026 is the sixteenth BlizzCon convention hosted by Blizzard Entertainment, announced on 11 March 2025 and scheduled to take place at the in Anaheim, California, from 12 to 13 September 2026. Ticket details were revealed on 5 November 2025, with availability throughout the month. The convention is expected to feature major franchise updates, developer panels, esports championships, and community showcases, continuing Blizzard's legacy of fan engagement and cross-title celebration.

The Bonechewer Messenger is a fel orc who spawns at the Bonechewer Ruins in Terokkar Forest along with four Bonechewer Marauders. They will ride on wolves towards Legion Hold in Shadowmoon Valley, where Wrathstalkers will spawn to attack them. In the event that they are not killed there, they will continue riding to Illidari Point, where they will despawn. He drops no loot.

Bonechewer Marauders are four fel orcs who spawn at the Bonechewer Ruins in Terokkar Forest along with the Bonechewer Messenger. They will ride on wolves towards Legion Hold in Shadowmoon Valley, where Wrathstalkers will spawn to attack them. In the event that they are not killed there, they will continue riding to Illidari Point, where they will despawn. They drop no loot.
